meta.name: standup
meta.description: Facilitate a read-only standup across git worktrees, branches, or PRs to compare changes and produce one consolidation plan.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 汇总多个分支或PR的变更，生成统一计划
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在多个工作分支间快速同步变更并制定合并计划
copy.tagline_en: Aggregate changes across branches or PRs into one consolidation plan
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly sync changes across multiple work branches and create a merge plan

howto.what: 安装后,Claude 会作为主持人,让每个 git 工作区、分支或 PR 作为独立发言方,在共享文档里进行多轮讨论;流程只读,最后产出一份合并方案,并用通俗语言向你汇报。
howto.when: 当用户要求对比多个 git 工作区、分支或 PR,并希望得到一份合并/整合方案时触发。

say.text: 把这些分支和 PR 组织个站会,对比改动,给我合并计划。
say.note: 会创建共享房间,各分支以代理身份发言。

say.text: 看看最近24小时有改动的工作区,帮我做个站会。
say.note: Claude 会按时间窗口拉取工作区并开始讨论。

say.text: 对比这两个工作区和一个 PR,确定合并目标和顺序。
say.note: 需要你确认最终决策后再交给 /do 执行。

howto.what_en: Claude acts as a facilitator: each git worktree, branch, or PR joins a shared chat, agents hold read-only rounds, and one consolidation plan comes out in plain language.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks to compare multiple git worktrees, branches, or PRs and wants one consolidation plan.

say_en.text: Run standup on these branches/PRs, compare changes, give consolidation plan.
say_en.note: Creates a shared room; each branch speaks as an agent.

say_en.text: Check worktrees changed in the last 24h and run a standup.
say_en.note: Claude selects worktrees by the time window and opens the room.

say_en.text: Compare these two worktrees and one PR; decide target and merge order.
say_en.note: You confirm final calls; then /do performs the merges.
